blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) enjoys security of tenure to maintain constitutional autonomy.
Removal of the CEC requires an impeachment process identical to that of a Supreme Court judge.
This stringent procedure ensures the independence of the Election Commission from executive influence.
The CEC is removed on the same grounds and in the same manner as a Supreme Court Judge, not at the pleasure of the President.
Impeachment security safeguards institutional independence from executive interference.
